ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle B=\angle C$, $AB=3$, what is the length of $AC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle B = \angle C$ and AB=3, \\
it follows that AB=AC=\boxed{3}.
